subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 freeze the proposed DSSE trust, publisher-feed, shard, query, and delta contract as the permanent Hosted Feed v1 interoperability and security boundary before the linked implementation tracks proceed?
rationale: The patch establishes wire-format and trust semantics that downstream OpenClaw and ClawHub implementations will treat as durable; repository evidence supplied here contains no maintainer-approved permanent scope or final interoperability proof.

options.title: Approve a staged publisher-first contract
options.body: Freeze only the publisher-first contract after maintainers approve the trust boundary and a final-head redacted interoperability transcript demonstrates it.

options.title: Narrow this RFC to core snapshots
options.body: Defer signed query and changed-since representations until their implementation and upgrade constraints have independent maintainer review.

options.title: Pause for a broader protocol review
options.body: Hold the RFC until OpenClaw and ClawHub owners agree on the durable versioning, compatibility, and key-rotation model.

recommendation.title: Approve a staged publisher-first contract
recommendation.body: Freeze only the publisher-first contract after maintainers approve the trust boundary and a final-head redacted interoperability transcript demonstrates it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only clearly evidenced author connected to both the original merged RFC baseline and the revised specification.
